name: SLS Baha Mar
positioning: High-energy resort hotel inside the Baha Mar complex in Nassau, The Bahamas, with a mostly adult crowd, a 20th-floor open-air bar and access to the Baha Bay waterpark
best_for: Travelers who want a high-energy resort with a mostly adult crowd
Families with young children who want a waterpark and free kids' meals

facts.text: SLS Baha Mar is part of Baha Mar, a resort destination in The Bahamas.
SLS Baha Mar sits inside the larger Baha Mar complex in Nassau.
Guest rooms and suites reflect a combination of modern baroque and Caribbean flair.
Superior rooms have Bahama-style shutters and locally designed furniture.
The residences have fully equipped kitchens and floor-to-ceiling glass doors.
Katsuya Baha Mar serves a fresh take on classic Japanese cuisine.
25° North serves Southern California coastal cuisine with ocean views.
The hotel lobby is anchored by the Monkey Bar.
Children ages 0 to 5 staying at the hotel eat free from the kids' menu at Cleo, Carna and Katsuya.
Royal Blue is an 18-hole, par-72 golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus.
Baha Bay has a FlowCurl surf simulator that requires no lessons.
SLS Baha Mar welcomes dogs as part of a pet-friendly program.

highlights.text: The ESPA at Baha Mar is the first flagship ESPA in the Caribbean.
SkyBar is an open-air bar on the hotel's 20th floor.
Carna Baha Mar is a contemporary steakhouse helmed by butcher Dario Cecchini.
SLS Baha Mar guests can use the Baha Bay beachfront waterpark.
At the Baha Mar wildlife sanctuary, guests can get close to sea turtles, stingrays, nurse sharks and native birds.

considerations.text: The crowd skews mostly adult, and SLS is the most high-energy hotel in the Baha Mar complex.
The hotel is about 15 minutes from downtown Nassau.
WhataHotel notes the large resort complex may feel less intimate.
